en-US.author: BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED
en-US.description: An always-on desktop app of autonomous AI employees that work inside your IM chats
en-US.longDescription:
Autonomous AI employees, on the job. Embedded where you and your teammates already work, it starts the moment a need appears and carries the task through to delivery.
- A teammate in the IM chat — after a long thread, just @ it with "turn this into a plan", waker already knows what just happened.
- Autonomously start work on its own — IM messages, schedules, hook events, or API calls, any of these four can trigger it started.
- Multiple wakers, working together — one task, split across roles: they work in parallel, hand off as needed, and review each other — fully traceable.
Three underlying systems let them get real work done on the front line:
- Harness engineering for stable delivery — task state persists, failures recover, and critical steps come with verification and retry. Work spanning hours or days keeps moving toward the goal.
- Your first AI employee — every AI employee has a name, a role, an onboarding date, scoped permissions, and a traceable record. Review what it did and how well it delivered, just like any team member.
- Job skills continuously expand — the built-in role skill library supports custom skills, so digital employee capabilities extend continuously with your needs.
- Acts inside your existing workflows — it works right inside group chats, approvals, docs, sheets, and internal systems, never crossing its permission boundaries.
- Customize for each profession — systematically built for each role: skills, methods, and judgment. Not a generic model wearing a role-shaped prompt.
- Knowledge retention and continuous evolution — you can view, correct, or forget any memory, letting your digital employee forget faulty context. Every collaboration builds shared knowledge.
- Secure, governable, accountable — each role gets its own identity and least-privilege access; sensitive actions require approval and critical actions are fully logged, so automation never crosses your enterprise boundary.
en-US.name: QoderWake
en-US.releaseNotes:
Memory Privacy and Experience Improvements

Improvements
- Memory Visibility: When “Allow non-sensitive memories to be publicly visible” is turned off, newly generated memories default to “This contact only.” Changing this setting does not alter existing memories’ visibility.
- Public Project Creation: Clicking “New” on the Public Projects tab of a Waker page opens the public-project creation flow for the current device.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed app updates failing to recover after partial completion, manual retries not proceeding, and updates failing with custom installation directories on Windows.
- Fixed Autonomous Work details briefly appearing empty or incorrectly reported as unavailable during runs, saves, or event refreshes. The latest details now remain after consecutive refreshes.
- Fixed read results still appearing as “Pending” on the Task Board. Pending items are now retained when synchronization fails and resolve correctly after a retry.
- Fixed IM pairings configured only for groups or WakerFlow being unable to display shared group memories and group member memories, as well as an inaccurate empty state when no records exist.

zh-CN.description: 在即时通讯中工作的全天候自主 AI 员工桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
在真实工作现场自主工作的数字员工。深入你和同事共处的工作现场，在需求发生的地方主动开工，把任务从需求做到交付。
- 进群即同事，不必从零解释 —— 群里聊了半天，@它一句「整理成方案」，它知道「刚才发生了什么」。
- 无需指挥，自己开工 —— 被 IM 消息、定时、Hooks 事件、API 调用——四种情况它都能自己开始工作。
- 多个岗位，协同分工 —— 任务自动拆给不同岗位，各自并行推进、按需交接，关键步骤互相复核，全程可追溯。
三个底层系统，支撑它在真实工作现场干活：
- 驾驭工程驱动长时运行稳定交付 —— 任务状态持续保存，失败可恢复，关键步骤带有验证与重试机制。工作跨越小时或多天，仍能沿着目标继续推进。
- 你的第一位数字员工 —— 每位数字员工拥有姓名、岗位、入职日期、权限和可追溯档案，像管理团队成员一样查看它做过什么、产出如何。
- 岗位技能不断扩展 —— 内置岗位技能库，支持自定义 Skill。数字员工的能力，随你的需求持续扩展。
- 在你现有的工作流里直接行动 —— 在群聊、审批、文档、表格、系统里直接干活，不越权限边界。
- 为每个岗位定制 —— 针对每个专业岗位系统构建能力——技能、方法、判断。不是通用模型穿角色外衣，是真正为这个岗位训练出来的员工。
- 记忆沉淀与持续进化 —— 你可以查看、纠正、遗忘任何一条记忆，让数字员工忘记错误上下文。每一次合作都在沉淀。
- 安全可控，有据可查 —— 为每个岗位配置独立身份与最小权限，敏感操作需要审批，关键动作完整留痕，让自动化不越过企业边界。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
记忆隐私与使用体验优化

体验优化
- 记忆可见范围：关闭“允许非敏感记忆公开可见”后，新生成的记忆默认为“本联系人可见”；切换此设置不会更改已有记忆的可见范围。
- 公开项目创建：在 Waker 的“公开项目”页签点击“新建”，可进入当前设备的公开项目创建流程。

问题修复
- 修复应用更新在部分完成后无法恢复、手动重试失效，以及 Windows 自定义安装目录下无法继续的问题。
- 修复自主工作详情在运行、保存或事件刷新时短暂清空或误报不存在的问题，连续刷新后会保留最新详情。
- 修复任务看板中的结果已标记为已读后仍显示“待查收”的问题；同步失败时会保留待处理项，并可在重试后正常收敛。
- 修复仅配置群组或 WakerFlow 的 IM 配对无法查看群通用记忆、群成员记忆，以及无记录时空态不准确的问题。
